name: git-guardrails
description: Stops agents from merging PRs, pushing to protected branches, deleting remote branches or destroying git history unless you said so.

block_merges.title: Block merges
block_merges.description: Deny gh pr merge, merges through the GitHub API (REST and GraphQL) and git merge while a protected branch is checked out.

protected_branches.title: Protected branches
protected_branches.description: Branches nobody pushes to without your go. A * glob works, for example release/*.

block_branch_delete.title: Block remote branch deletion
block_branch_delete.description: Deny push --delete, empty-source refspecs, refspecs fed by an unguarded variable, --mirror, --prune and gh pr close --delete-branch.

block_destructive.title: Block history-destroying git
block_destructive.description: Deny git reset --hard, git clean -f, git branch -D, git stash drop and git stash clear.

strict.title: Strict mode
strict.description: Also deny every git commit and git push, so the agent has to ask before anything leaves your machine.
